archive_record.description_rewritten: Agia Fotini is listed as a small natural-area cruising spot near Zappeion, described only as beneath a bridge and in bushes. The place name might be a religious or neighbourhood landmark but the accessible source does not identify which bridge, so it must not be confused with other Agia Fotini churches in Athens. A 2025 firsthand comment calls it a pleasant place but says nobody was there; the newer March 2026 country-feed activity is blank. No identifiable 2026 visit or confirmed encounter is available.
archive_record.location_identity: Unspecified bridge/bush area in central Athens about 400m from Zappeion in directory proximity list. Exact crossing and public path not independently confirmed.
archive_record.access_conditions: Unknown bridge underpass and vegetated space; accessibility, ownership, flood/traffic safety and any park gates unverified. Do not route users through unmarked traffic infrastructure.

archive_record.description_rewritten: Syntagma Square has municipal public restrooms on its Othonos Street side, distinct from toilets inside Syntagma metro. The Athens tourism office independently identifies public toilets at the square. The cruising directory claims its urinals attract men, but multiple first-person January 2026 commenters describe the site as quiet, with cleaning staff or security nearby, while older comments disagree. This supports recent unsuccessful visits rather than a verified current cruising scene; the undated 'all day' label is not reliable operator opening information.
archive_record.location_identity: Public square restroom on the Othonos Street side of Syntagma Square, central Athens. Do not conflate with station accessible WC requiring staff access.
archive_record.access_conditions: Public municipal restroom; hours, stall/urinal layout and operator access policy not independently checked. Municipal cleaning/security presence reported by visitors. Privacy, consent and nonparticipating members of public must be respected; tourist listing of toilets is not permission for sexual encounters.
